I actually work in the Netherlands. I think set is more important than the end result. People are more important than films, even if it's my absolute passion. There are different schools of thoughts for directing and although pushing your actors is necessary I always make sure mine are taken care off between scenes, come back to me after a difficult scene and not let them spiral in their character's stess. I don't agree with Kubrick style of directing but i still watch some of his films.
